cdstr.title: Workshop Service Manager
cdstr.summary: A Quasar, Vue and Firebase system for auto shop operations, tracking customers, services, appointments, status, and invoices.
cdstr.overview: A workshop operations platform that centralizes client records, service catalogs, schedule planning, appointment status, and invoice generation into a single responsive dashboard.

architecture.0: Quasar + Vue frontend with responsive workshop management panels
architecture.1: Firebase backend for realtime client data, service scheduling, and authenticated access
architecture.2: Service workflow views for appointment status, work orders, and invoice tracking

challenges.0: Mapping vehicle service workflows into intuitive appointment and status boards
challenges.1: Ensuring realtime synchronization of customer, service, and invoice records in Firebase
challenges.2: Keeping the workshop interface clear for busy teams while managing schedules and service updates

flwrx.title: FloWorks Studio
flwrx.summary: An interactive tool for plansifter flow schema design, inlet/outlet visualization, and schema data management with Quasar, Vue, Firebase, and animated SVGs.
flwrx.overview: A workflow application to define plansifter flow paths, visualize inlets and outlets, and store schematics, material profiles, and process metadata in Firebase.

architecture.0: Vue and Quasar frontend with a responsive schematic editor
architecture.1: Firebase backend for schema storage, authentication, and real-time synchronization
architecture.2: Animated SVG visualizations for inlet/outlet flow and process feedback

challenges.0: Building an intuitive plansifter flow editor with scalable SVG rendering
challenges.1: Keeping schema state and metadata synchronized between Firebase and the UI preview
challenges.2: Balancing engineering detail with a polished interactive experience for operators

benhaqui.title: Benhaqui Condo Exchange
benhaqui.summary: A community service exchange platform for condominium residents to offer and request local help like meal preparation, groceries, lessons, and neighborhood referrals.
benhaqui.overview: A neighborhood services platform where apartment residents post the services they can provide or the help they need, making it easy for co-residents in the same condominium to connect on offers, requests, and referrals.

architecture.0: Vue and Quasar frontend with resident service listings, request boards, and condominium-level access controls
architecture.1: Firebase backend for authenticated resident profiles, service posting, and realtime updates
architecture.2: Matching-friendly UI for offer/request workflows, referrals, and condo community interactions

challenges.0: Designing a simple flow for residents to publish service offers and needs within the same condominium
challenges.1: Keeping the experience safe and discoverable while preserving local community context
challenges.2: Balancing offer/request visibility, referral sharing, and trust signals for neighbors

vittalinq.title: Vittalinq Clinic Manager
vittalinq.summary: A healthcare platform for small clinics to manage patient records, sessions, appointments, and care workflows.
vittalinq.overview: A clinic management system that centralizes client records, appointment scheduling, session notes, and team coordination into a responsive dashboard.

architecture.0: Vue and Quasar frontend for streamlined appointment and patient administration
architecture.1: Firebase backend for secure client records, session data, and authentication
architecture.2: Clinical workflow views for appointments, session tracking, and care history

challenges.0: Modeling clinic workflows and appointment flows in an easy-to-use interface
challenges.1: Organizing patient and session data while keeping the experience clear for providers
challenges.2: Balancing fast scheduling with accurate record keeping for care continuity
